integrity: Exact-rational and symbolic checks are supplied. The all-degree inference uses a proof of a Legendre bound, not finite extrapolation. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete four-basis systems in complex dimension three, one exact phase-invariant harmonic bidegree at a time; no assertion for weighted/incomplete systems, higher ambient dimensions, or nonlinear phase retrieval. Earlier Jacobi/association-scheme literature may contain implicit equivalent statements; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp all-degree harmonic interpolation and conditioning on qutrit mutually unbiased bases
